question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Gauge
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e.** "Measure."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Gauge" **is a verb that means to measure or estimate something, such as the size, amount, extent, or capacity of something.
 
• It can **also mean** to judge or assess something.(मापना)
 
• **"Measure" **is a verb that means to ascertain the size, amount, or degree of something by using an instrument or device marked in standard units or by comparing it with an object of known size. (नापना) 
 
• This is the** correct answer** because it means the same as** "gauge."**
 
• **Both terms** involve the assessment or determination of size, amount, extent, or capacity.

Therefore, the **correct answer **is:** 'Measure'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's explain all the given words:
 
 
• **"Diagnose"** is a verb used mainly in medical contexts, meaning to identify the nature of an illness or other problems by examination of the symptoms. (निदान करना)
 
• **"Valve"** is a noun referring to a device that controls the passage of fluid or air through a pipe, duct, etc., by opening, closing, or partially obstructing various passageways.(वाल्व)
 
• **"Attempt**" is a verb that means to try to do or achieve something.(प्रयास करना)
